name: New alternatives pages
description: New /alternatives/<slug> pages for tools that are not yet in alternatives-data.js. All 11 existing alternatives pages cover infrastructure-specific tools; these cover adjacent tools (sequencers with bundled infrastructure, lead platforms) whose users overlap with Infrabox's target buyer.

slugs.angle: Gmail-native mass senders looking for real-scale infrastructure
users wanting infrastructure without committing to the full Forge stack
sequencer users who need dedicated infrastructure for scale
Apollo users frustrated with bundled sending limits

notes: Each page follows the existing mailforge/zapmail structure in alternatives-data.js. Must include infraboxAlternative as the first entry and 5-7 real alternatives.
